description: Format the raw safety meeting notes located at /home/ga/Documents/site_42_safety_minutes.docx. You must: (1) Apply 'Heading 1' to the main title and 'Heading 2' to all section headers (Attendance, Previous Incidents, etc.). (2) Create a NEW Custom Paragraph Style named 'Action Item' (do not use direct formatting). This style must have: a Box border (all 4 sides), a Yellow-ish background color (e.g., Yellow or Light Yellow), and Indents (Left and Right) of exactly 0.50 inches. (3) Apply this 'Action Item' style to the 4 paragraphs in the text that start with 'ACTION:'. (4) Insert a Table of Contents at the top of the document (after the title). (5) Save the final document as /home/ga/Documents/site_42_formatted.docx.
